title: update_sleep_log_with_invalid_values
description: Test updating a sleep log with invalid values such as sleepQuality greater than 10 or hoursSlept greater than 24 to verify the API returns a 400 validation error.

title: delete_sleep_log_and_verify_removal
description: Test deleting a sleep log by id and then attempting to retrieve it to confirm it returns 404 not found, ensuring proper deletion and ownership enforcement.

title: update_injury_with_invalid_severity
description: Test updating an injury record with a severity value outside the allowed range (1-10) to verify the API returns a 400 validation error.

title: delete_injury_and_verify_removal
description: Test deleting an injury record by id and then attempting to retrieve it to confirm it returns 404 not found, ensuring proper deletion and ownership enforcement.

title: search_gyms_with_missing_query_parameter
description: Test the gym search endpoint without the required query parameter 'q' to verify the API returns a 400 validation error.

title: nearby_gyms_with_invalid_radius
description: Test the nearby gyms endpoint with a radius parameter exceeding the maximum allowed value (greater than 50000) to verify the API returns a 400 validation error.
